parent_objective: materialize no-rollout bounded calibration smoke subset
blocked_by: need bounded smoke subset preflight before any execution
supersedes: direct execution of the full M1702 10368-cell matrix

public_gates: M1705 must materialize a no-rollout 864-cell bounded smoke subset
M1705 must select 6 source-diverse base specs with 3 T4 and 3 T5 specs
M1705 must preserve all 12 calibration variants per selected base spec
M1705 must preserve all 12 controller-family profiles per calibration spec
M1705 must preserve P0 no-wheel no-oracle actor contract for every env variant
M1705 must not execute rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1705 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, private-holdout evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes the bounded smoke subset after M1704 design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rollout subset preflight only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if selected subset is not 864 cells
stop if selected base specs do not cover 3 T4 and 3 T5 specs
stop if any calibration axis or required profile is dropped
stop if any env variant violates P0 contract
fallback_plan: route to selection repair if subset coverage fails
route to bounded smoke audit if subset is clean
route to branch stop if source diversity cannot be preserved
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1704 admits bounded smoke subset preflight

training_stage.stage_objective: materialize no-rollout bounded calibration smoke subset

blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification

M1705 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up bounded smoke audit manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1705 is infrastructure and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: preflight must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset controls for later smoke
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the subset cannot preserve task/source/profile coverage, stop before execution.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1704 bounded calibration smoke subset can be materialized as a no-rollout 864-cell matrix with clean contract checks.
success_criteria: selected_base_specs.csv contains 6 rows with 3 T4 and 3 T5 specs
all 12 profiles appear for each selected calibration spec
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: selected subset does not match the M1704 scale
required task family calibration axis or profile coverage is missing
any env variant violates P0 contract
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
